item: BACKLOG spcc-sensor-curve stage 2 (GO #3b, director astro-imaging-45, worker this session): the 22 canonical SPCC products re-calibrated under the recipe pin "Nikon Z f" — ONE knob (the response curve); the existing canonical _wcs.fit is the input everywhere (no re-solve); the index-0 products and PNGs moved aside first

premises_untested: the guard's centre rows are BLIND to K by construction: SPCC's background offsets pin the neutralised sky of every channel to the R level (K_R = 1, b_R identical old/new on every product), so the level rows read identical to the baseline to 0.1 ADU16 on all 17 sets; its PASS is not a measurement of the +1.4%/+2.2% K change — the structure rows are within-channel ratios (scale-invariant) and moved only through the offsets (two dipoles: aug14/set-05 -0.0289 -> -0.0302, july31/set-02 +0.0045 -> +0.0051)

kept-star SET identity between the old and new run of each product is by count only (n_kept equal on all 22); the photometry does not see the curve, which the equal counts are consistent with, not proof of
the PNGs were checked by IHDR (16-bit RGB, canvas = NAXIS1 x NAXIS2) and size; their content was not viewed — H4 on the 21 products other than july31/set-01 is the owner's

routing of the 4 unions through set-01 of each night and of the corpus through aug09/set-02 follows the campaign's records (input identity + commit a34626a), not a re-derivation of finish_render's CALSETS/REGREF rule
the idx0 identities are bytes + head/tail/size sha256[:32] (baseline_guard's form) taken before and after the rename, not a full sha256

the old logs survive only as untracked session scratch (<name>.idx0.log); the old sigma/intercept-share numbers in this record are reproducible from those copies alone — git holds the old K/b/n records, not the logs
run-to-run determinism is assumed from the july31/set-01 repeat (arm zf2 = arm zf to the digit); no product was run twice here

the driver's first pass keyed its done-list by tag alone and skipped 13 products whose tag repeats across nights; the key was corrected (session/set/tag), the 9 finished results migrated by their own .ssf session path, and the 13 run in a second pass (10:40:33-10:41:49) — nothing was overwritten or run twice (every product's pre-run assertion: canonical _spcc and PNG absent)
the SPCC wall times (2.1-5.0 s) and PNG saves (2.8-7.2 s) are from a local-catalogue run on this rig; the doc's 'five full runs of ~2-3 min' was an estimate, not a measurement
